in_sanskrit.name: Vanshvansh
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है prosperity tree
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Vanshvansh एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Vanshvansh is a combination of two words: Vansh (prosperity tree) and Vansh (descendants, dynasty). This name is a symbol of prosperity, longevity, power, and protection. It is believed that this name brings wealth and prosperity to the family for generations.
